narrative.title: The k-th Silent Slot in an ID Sequence
narrative.scenario: A ticketing system allocates strictly increasing IDs, but outages left gaps in the issued sequence. Auditors reference issues by counting gaps - the k-th positive integer that was never issued. Find that value from the sorted list of issued IDs without walking every integer.
narrative.inputFormat: An array arr of n strictly increasing positive integers and an integer k.
narrative.outputFormat: The k-th positive integer missing from arr.
constraints: arr is sorted in strictly increasing order

testCases.explanation: The missing IDs are 1, 5, 6, 8, 9 in order, so the fifth gap is 9.
Nothing is missing inside the range, so the gaps continue past the last ID: 5 then 6.

hintLevels: Level 1: Before any index i, exactly arr[i] - (i + 1) positive integers are missing - a count that only grows with i.
Level 2: Binary search for the first index whose missing-count reaches k; the answer relates that index back to k.
Level 3: If no index accumulates k gaps, the answer lies past the last ID and equals the array length plus k; otherwise it is found just before the first index that crosses the threshold.
